method: Root manual unblinded inspection of every complete immutable endpoint patch, exact public APIs, delivered tests, command chronology and delivery. Hash-bound independent endpoint checks support the judgment; official completion alone is insufficient. Symbolic relevance/witness judgments require separate explicit review.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-reference
evidence: Reviewed all public generic signatures, three source files, new tests, commands and delivery. Introduced behavioral regression: normalizeCount leaves finite counts above length unclamped; length=2,count=3 yields slice(-1) / slice(0,-1), so takeLast returns one item and dropLast retains one rather than all/empty. This violates preserved integer behavior and fails the hidden oracle. New tests omit finite length<count<2*length. Selected original, source and delivered runtime/type checks all pass after final edit at 31-33/35; scope reporting is honest and no original checks are weakened. No retrieval or solver claim. Failure is model logic plus insufficient cases, not a reported test pass proving user criteria.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-candidate
evidence: Reviewed both public generic APIs, shared scalar helper and all new table-driven tests. Finite positives floor, NaN/nonpositives map to zero and positive infinity to length; preserving Math.max(0,length-count) prevents negative slice indexes when finite counts exceed length. Fresh readonly/generic arrays and data-first/last/pipe behavior are correct. Required commands 43-45 and delivered types 47 follow final edits; all five endpoint checks and dependency integrity pass. Formatter attempts 31/32 are refused/unavailable in the pinned offline environment; no dependency is installed and final delivery reports that limitation. No retrieval or solver claim; selected/full-suite distinction is honest.
